orange click connectors on panel edges
5 finishes: Alpine White, White Oak, Ink Blue, Fern Green, Raven Black

vo_script.line: Upgrade your laundry room with the Glacier Bay Drop-In Laundry Sink with Faucet and Ready to Assemble Cabinet with CLICKREADY Technology — where style meets simplicity.
Designed with exclusive CLICKREADY Technology, assembly is 3X faster than traditional cabinets because there's no tools, glue, or screws required. Just push, click, and connect.
The 9-inch deep, 9 gallon stainless steel sink includes a grid basket strainer, and the pull-down faucet makes cleanups simple.
Choose from five durable, chip-resistant finishes - Alpine White, White Oak, Ink Blue, Fern Green, and Raven Black...
...each with brushed nickel hardware and soft-close doors for a polished, modern look.
Transform your laundry room into something you'll love. It's fast, easy and available only at the Home Depot.
